before.name: Benjamin Nowain
before.description: Benjamin Nowain is a Shasta County community activist who challenged local officials at public meetings. Sheriff’s deputies arrested him at a board of supervisors meeting on January 6, 2026, after he spoke from the audience, received a warning and refused an order to leave. Shasta Scout reported the arrest in the context of concerns about free speech at county meetings. Shasta Unfiltered reported that he was released and returned to the meeting that day. No conviction or later disposition is established by those reports.
